title: Lilac Belvedere
description: An expansive double waltz unfolds in E-flat. Long upper phrases first float over paired dance steps; an independent middle voice then turns beneath them, bringing the music into fuller sunlight. The inherited descent arrives only on the return, followed by a quiet, open-ended coda.
technical_note: Hear two broad waltz measures inside each 6/4 bar. In the central section, sustain the upper voice while the inner fingers keep dancing; give the inner line less weight. Keep pedal changes distinct from finger legato.

performance.note: Deliberate dance pulse, shaped phrases and terraced dynamics; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
